# REKS Studio

> REKS(N,M) / SA-REKS / SI-REKS ensemble DFT in Psi4: user manual, option reference, example inputs.

Psi4 e95c2d234, 2026-10-19: the commit of every output on this site. Install: branch kk/reks.studio of <https://github.com/ConstLike/psi4>.

## Options
- [`REKS`](/options/REKS.md): Active space `[N, M]`: N active electrons in M active orbitals; selects the catalog.
- [`SA_REKS_CONFIGS`](/options/SA_REKS_CONFIGS.md): SA-REKS configuration pool: one block (flat list) or one block per spin manifold (nested list) of names, indices or bulk tokens.
- [`SA_REKS_2SPIN`](/options/SA_REKS_2SPIN.md): Spin manifold 2S of each SA block, one integer per block.
- [`SA_REKS_WEIGHTS`](/options/SA_REKS_WEIGHTS.md): Weights of the SA pool entries, configurations first, then the `sa_reks_extra` determinants; non-negative, summing to 1.
- [`SA_REKS_EXTRA`](/options/SA_REKS_EXTRA.md): Extra Slater determinants of the SA ensemble, as occupation vectors; each has its own weight, carries no FON and enters no SI cassette.
- [`SI_REKS_CONFIGS`](/options/SI_REKS_CONFIGS.md): SI-SA-REKS cassettes: the configuration sets whose secular equations give the states, in groups per spin manifold.
- [`SI_REKS_2SPIN`](/options/SI_REKS_2SPIN.md): 2S of each SI group; more than one entry requires the 3-level `si_reks_configs` form.
- [`SI_REKS_PRINT_STATES`](/options/SI_REKS_PRINT_STATES.md): States per cassette whose per-state and pair tables are printed; 0 = none, -1 = all.
- [`SI_REKS_STORE_STATES`](/options/SI_REKS_STORE_STATES.md): States per cassette whose properties are stored on the wavefunction (arrays, Molden and cube files); 0 = none, -1 = all.
- [`SI_REKS_ANALYSIS`](/options/SI_REKS_ANALYSIS.md): State-property blocks of the SI states to compute, print and store (moments, charges, bond indices, NTO, exciton, …).
- [`SI_REKS_ANALYSIS_CHANGE_MIN`](/options/SI_REKS_ANALYSIS_CHANGE_MIN.md): Smallest state-to-state change of a charge or bond index that is printed.
- [`SI_REKS_OVERLAP_CUTOFF`](/options/SI_REKS_OVERLAP_CUTOFF.md): Overlap eigenvalues <code>s ≤ cutoff · s<sub>max</sub></code> of the SI basis are treated as null space and dropped.
- [`SI_REKS_SOLVER`](/options/SI_REKS_SOLVER.md): Eigensolver of each SI cassette: LAPACK on every root, or Davidson on the lowest roots.
- [`SI_REKS_DAVIDSON_R_CONVERGENCE`](/options/SI_REKS_DAVIDSON_R_CONVERGENCE.md): Residual norm in E_h each Davidson root of the SI problem converges to.
- [`REKS_GEMINAL_WIDTHS`](/options/REKS_GEMINAL_WIDTHS.md): Units of the active space: electron or hole geminals, electron or hole doublets, one token each; selects the catalog.
- [`SI_REKS_GRAD`](/options/SI_REKS_GRAD.md): Roots whose analytic gradients are computed, per cassette; the first listed root is followed (`CURRENT ENERGY`, returned gradient).
- [`SI_REKS_NAC`](/options/SI_REKS_NAC.md): Root pairs `[I, J]` per cassette whose nonadiabatic couplings and conical-intersection topography are computed.
- [`SI_REKS_PROPERTY_FOR`](/options/SI_REKS_PROPERTY_FOR.md): States, per cassette, whose dipole, quadrupole, charges and bond indices are evaluated with the relaxed (CP-REKS) density.
- [`REKS_EKT`](/options/REKS_EKT.md): Enables EKT: ionization energies, pole strengths and Dyson orbitals of the `si_reks_property_for` states or of the SA ensemble.
- [`REKS_EKT_OCC_TOL`](/options/REKS_EKT_OCC_TOL.md): Cutoff on the density eigenvalues: those at or below it are dropped from the EKT metric.
- [`REKS_CPREKS_CONV`](/options/REKS_CPREKS_CONV.md): Residual threshold of the CP-REKS (Z-vector) solver. `reks_cpreks_maxiter` (200) bounds its rounds.
- [`REKS_CPREKS_MAXITER`](/options/REKS_CPREKS_MAXITER.md): Maximum number of rounds of the CP-REKS (Z-vector) solver; exceeding it stops the run with the residual reached.
- [`REKS_GRAD_DEGEN_TOL`](/options/REKS_GRAD_DEGEN_TOL.md): Gap below which a requested root is flagged as quasi-degenerate.
- [`REKS_CI_TOPOGRAPHY_GAP`](/options/REKS_CI_TOPOGRAPHY_GAP.md): Largest gap at which the topography table of a NAC pair is printed.
- [`GUESS_ACTIVE_WINDOW`](/options/GUESS_ACTIVE_WINDOW.md): MOs of the read guess placed in the active columns, one token per active orbital: 0-based index, `HOMO-k` or `LUMO+k`.
- [`REKS_FON_INTERP_DELTA`](/options/REKS_FON_INTERP_DELTA.md): Parameter δ of the factor f(n_p n_q) that multiplies the coupling term of each geminal in the REKS energy.
- [`REKS_<L>_FON`](/options/REKS_N_FON.md): Lower bound on the free FON n_p of every geminal of one FON generation (`reks_n_fon`, `reks_m_fon`, …); negative disables it.
- [`REKS_FON_MICRO_NR_MAXITER`](/options/REKS_FON_MICRO_NR_MAXITER.md): Newton iteration cap per geminal block per SCF iteration.
- [`REKS_FON_MICRO_LS_MAXITER`](/options/REKS_FON_MICRO_LS_MAXITER.md): Armijo backtracking (step halving) cap inside one Newton step.
- [`REKS_FON_MICRO_CONVERGENCE`](/options/REKS_FON_MICRO_CONVERGENCE.md): Step-norm convergence threshold.
- [`REKS_FON_MICRO_MIN_EIGENVALUE`](/options/REKS_FON_MICRO_MIN_EIGENVALUE.md): Floor on the absolute eigenvalues of the reduced Hessian; negative curvature is flipped.
- [`REKS_FON_MICRO_BOUND_MARGIN`](/options/REKS_FON_MICRO_BOUND_MARGIN.md): Margin m of the SCF FON box \[ℓ, 2 − m] kept by the FON micro-solver and the TRAH step, in (0, 1); SI box: `SI_REKS_FON_BOUND_MARGIN`.
- [`SI_REKS_FON_BOUND_MARGIN`](/options/SI_REKS_FON_BOUND_MARGIN.md): Margin m of the box \[m, 2 − m] of the SI-only FONs ([SI-only FONs](/manual/concepts/index.md#si-only-fons)) and of their CP-REKS at-bound test, in \[0, 1).
- [`REKS_FON_MICRO_BOUNDARY_SKIN`](/options/REKS_FON_MICRO_BOUNDARY_SKIN.md): A generation-0 multi-start seed landing within this distance of 0 or 2 counts as boundary-trapped and loses to an interior minimum.
- [`REKS_GEMINAL_DELOC`](/options/REKS_GEMINAL_DELOC.md): After the SCF, rotates generation-0 pairs past the IPR midpoint to their IPR minimum and reconverges; kept if lower in E_SA.
- [`REKS_REPORT_LEVEL`](/options/REKS_REPORT_LEVEL.md): Verbosity of the REKS output, 1–5: from the SCF trace and energetics up to per-iteration solver traces and intermediate matrices.
- [`REKS_USE_TRAH`](/options/REKS_USE_TRAH.md): Trust-region Newton (TRAH) step on the active–active rotations and FONs: warm-up before GVB-DIIS, or the whole SCF without it.
- [`REKS_GVB_DIIS`](/options/REKS_GVB_DIIS.md): GVB-DIIS accelerator of the orbital optimization, in the formulation set by `reks_diis_formulation`.
- [`REKS_DIIS_FORMULATION`](/options/REKS_DIIS_FORMULATION.md): GVB-DIIS formulation: extrapolation of the orbital-rotation generators κ, or of the composite multishell Fock matrix (`CFM`).
- [`REKS_GVB_DIIS_START`](/options/REKS_GVB_DIIS_START.md): First SCF iteration of GVB-DIIS; earlier iterations run the level-shifted burn-in or TRAH.
- [`REKS_GVB_LEVEL_SHIFT`](/options/REKS_GVB_LEVEL_SHIFT.md): Shell gap of the multishell Fock matrix in the `CFM` formulation of GVB-DIIS.
- [`LEVEL_SHIFT_ADAPT`](/options/LEVEL_SHIFT_ADAPT.md): Adaptive base of the staircase level shift: decays while the orbitals are stable, grows back up to `level_shift` on swaps or strong mixing.
- [`REKS_DIIS_ACTIVATION`](/options/REKS_DIIS_ACTIVATION.md): Criterion for `ORBITAL` GVB-DIIS to take over from the TRAH warm-up: the iteration count alone, or also the orbital gradient.
- [`REKS_DIIS_CFM_ACTIVATION_GORB`](/options/REKS_DIIS_CFM_ACTIVATION_GORB.md): Orbital-gradient norm ‖g_orb‖\_F below which GVB-DIIS takes over from the TRAH warm-up.
- [`REKS_GVB_ROBUST_VERDICT`](/options/REKS_GVB_ROBUST_VERDICT.md): Enables the post-hoc verdict that rewinds extrapolated GVB-DIIS steps whose orbital gradient grows.
- [`REKS_DIIS_COND_ANGLE_FILTER`](/options/REKS_DIIS_COND_ANGLE_FILTER.md): Enables the angle filter with stale-drop that prunes near-dependent and stale GVB-DIIS error vectors.
- [`REKS_DIIS_COND_ANGLE_CUTOFF`](/options/REKS_DIIS_COND_ANGLE_CUTOFF.md): Angle-filter cutoff c_s: smallest sine of the angle to the kept differences for a GVB-DIIS error vector to stay.
- [`REKS_DIIS_COND_STALE_DELTA`](/options/REKS_DIIS_COND_STALE_DELTA.md): Stale-drop threshold δ: GVB-DIIS error vectors with norm above the newest norm / √δ are dropped; 0 switches it off.
- [`REKS_DIIS_COND_KAPPA_BYPASS`](/options/REKS_DIIS_COND_KAPPA_BYPASS.md): Condition number of the GVB-DIIS error matrix above which the SVD-conditioned solve replaces the plain bordered solve.
- [`REKS_DIIS_COND_SVD_RCOND`](/options/REKS_DIIS_COND_SVD_RCOND.md): Relative singular-value cutoff of the SVD-conditioned GVB-DIIS solve.
- [`REKS_DIIS_COND_COEFF_NORM_MAX`](/options/REKS_DIIS_COND_COEFF_NORM_MAX.md): Bound c_max on the GVB-DIIS coefficient norm |c|², also used by the angle filter to drop near-duplicate error vectors.
- [`REKS_DIIS_COND_TIKHONOV`](/options/REKS_DIIS_COND_TIKHONOV.md): Enables the Tikhonov ridge on the SVD-conditioned GVB-DIIS solve.
- [`REKS_DIIS_COND_TIKHONOV_SCALE`](/options/REKS_DIIS_COND_TIKHONOV_SCALE.md): Ridge magnitude of the Tikhonov-regularized GVB-DIIS SVD solve; 0 applies no ridge.
- [`REKS_DIIS_MON_VERDICT_RHO`](/options/REKS_DIIS_MON_VERDICT_RHO.md): Verdict trip ratio: a GVB-DIIS step is rewound when ‖g_orb‖ exceeds this multiple of its maximum over the recent iterates.
- [`REKS_DIIS_MON_VERDICT_STREAK`](/options/REKS_DIIS_MON_VERDICT_STREAK.md): Consecutive verdict rewinds without a new best iterate before GVB-DIIS restarts from the best iterate.
- [`REKS_DIIS_MON_SUPPRESS_WINDOW`](/options/REKS_DIIS_MON_SUPPRESS_WINDOW.md): Iterations after a GVB-DIIS rewind, restart or switch during which the verdict is suspended.
- [`REKS_DIIS_MON_NONMONOTONE_M`](/options/REKS_DIIS_MON_NONMONOTONE_M.md): Depth M of the nonmonotone references of the GVB-DIIS monitors: max ‖g_orb‖ and min E_SA over the last M iterates.
- [`REKS_GVB_GATE_STREAK`](/options/REKS_GVB_GATE_STREAK.md): Consecutive iterations meeting the energy and gradient thresholds before GVB-DIIS reports convergence.
- [`REKS_DIIS_GUARD_LATCH_GRACE`](/options/REKS_DIIS_GUARD_LATCH_GRACE.md): Consecutive iterations without the basin signal after which the GVB-DIIS outcome guard clears its basin latch.
- [`REKS_DIIS_GUARD_LANDING_TOLERANCE`](/options/REKS_DIIS_GUARD_LANDING_TOLERANCE.md): Relative tolerance at which a GVB-DIIS rewind landing counts as a repeat (best E_SA and best ‖g_orb‖ reproduced).
- [`REKS_DIIS_MON_PROGRESS_EPS`](/options/REKS_DIIS_MON_PROGRESS_EPS.md): Sufficient-decrease fraction ε: a GVB-DIIS iterate counts as progress only if ‖g_orb‖ ≤ (1 − ε) × best ‖g_orb‖.
- [`REKS_DIIS_FON_BRANCH_CUTOFF`](/options/REKS_DIIS_FON_BRANCH_CUTOFF.md): FON displacement from the best iterate at or above which the GVB-DIIS guard reads an energy drop as a basin transition.
- [`REKS_DIIS_RESTART_BUDGET`](/options/REKS_DIIS_RESTART_BUDGET.md): GVB-DIIS monitor restarts without sufficient improvement allowed before the monitors stop and rewind once to the best iterate.
- [`REKS_DIIS_MON_CYCLE`](/options/REKS_DIIS_MON_CYCLE.md): Enables the GVB-DIIS no-progress / step-cap monitor, which restarts from the best iterate.
- [`REKS_DIIS_MON_CYCLE_WINDOW`](/options/REKS_DIIS_MON_CYCLE_WINDOW.md): Iterations without a new best ‖g_orb‖ before the GVB-DIIS cycle monitor restarts from the best iterate.
- [`REKS_DIIS_MON_CYCLE_CAP_STREAK`](/options/REKS_DIIS_MON_CYCLE_CAP_STREAK.md): Consecutive `ORBITAL` step-cap hits before the GVB-DIIS cycle monitor restarts.
- [`REKS_DIIS_ORB_BASE_MAP_DAMP`](/options/REKS_DIIS_ORB_BASE_MAP_DAMP.md): Damping α of the `ORBITAL` GVB-DIIS Newton step from the re-anchored frame after a restart.

## Files
- [inputs/first_butadiene.py](/inputs/first_butadiene.py.txt): SI-SA-REKS(4,4), s-trans-butadiene, BH\&HLYP/6-31G(d), RKS seed, π window
- [inputs/first_c2h4_90.py](/inputs/first_c2h4_90.py.txt): SI-SA-REKS(2,2), C₂H₄ 90°, BH\&HLYP/6-31G(d), RKS seed, no window
- [inputs/first_hexatriene.py](/inputs/first_hexatriene.py.txt): SI-SA-REKS(6,6), all-trans-hexatriene (QUEST geometry), BH\&HLYP/6-31G(d), RKS seed, π window with LUMO+3; default SA pool, all-α determinant in SA; SI on 2S = 0, 2, 4, 6
- [inputs/md_c2h4.py](/inputs/md_c2h4.py.txt): surface hopping on S1 from the `opt_c2h4.py` geometry, 3 states, 400 × 0.25 fs
- [inputs/md_hexatriene.py](/inputs/md_hexatriene.py.txt): surface hopping on T1 from the `opt_hexatriene.py` geometry, 3 triplet states, 50 × 0.5 fs
- [inputs/opt_c2h4.py](/inputs/opt_c2h4.py.txt): S0 of C₂H₄, SSR(2,2) BH\&HLYP/6-31G(d), DF, RKS seed, DL-FIND
- [inputs/opt_hexatriene.py](/inputs/opt_hexatriene.py.txt): T1 of all-trans-hexatriene, SI-SA-REKS(6,6) BH\&HLYP/6-31G(d), DF, π window, DL-FIND
- [inputs/reks22_h2.dat](/inputs/reks22_h2.dat.txt): SI-SA-REKS(2,2), H₂ (0.74 Å), BH\&HLYP/cc-pVDZ, default pools
- [inputs/reks22_h2_triplet_gradient.dat](/inputs/reks22_h2_triplet_gradient.dat.txt): SI-SA-REKS(2,2), H₂ (1.6 Å), BH\&HLYP/6-31G(d); analytic gradient and relaxed properties of T1 ([`SI_REKS_GRAD`](/options/SI_REKS_GRAD.md))
- [inputs/reks44_h4_heisenberg.dat](/inputs/reks44_h4_heisenberg.dat.txt): SI-SA-REKS(4,4), linear H₄ (1.6 Å), BH\&HLYP/6-31G, PK; default SA pool, all-α determinant for SCF stability; full SI cassettes on 2S = 0, 2, 4; [Spin-state gaps and Heisenberg J](/manual/properties/index.md#spin-state-energetics)
- [inputs/reks44_h4_singlet_triplet.py](/inputs/reks44_h4_singlet_triplet.py.txt): SI-SA-REKS(4,4), linear H₄ (1.6 Å), BH\&HLYP/6-31G, DF; default SA pool, all-α determinant for SCF stability; full SI cassette on 2S = 0 and 2S = 2
- [inputs/reks_dlfind.py](/inputs/reks_dlfind.py.txt): `optimize(method, molecule, restart_file, tolerance=4.5e-4, maxcycle=100)`: DL-FIND L-BFGS in delocalized internal coordinates on the target root; `tolerance`: largest gradient component in those coordinates, atomic units
- [inputs/reks_unixmd.py](/inputs/reks_unixmd.py.txt): `molecule(xyz_file, nstates, temperature, charge=0, seed=1)`, `REKS(molecule, method, restart_file)`: PyUNIxMD QM interface, roots of cassette 0
- [inputs/wide_bh_23.py](/inputs/wide_bh_23.py.txt): BH lone pair, HF/cc-pVDZ, δ = 10<sup>10</sup>: RHF seed; REKS(2,2); REKS(2,3); REKS(2,3) with σ\* in the window; CASSCF(2,3)
- [inputs/wide_bh_45.py](/inputs/wide_bh_45.py.txt): BH bond + lone pair, HF/cc-pVDZ, δ = 10<sup>10</sup>: REKS(4,4); REKS(4,5) from RHF; seed chain REKS(2,3) → REKS(4,5) → REKS(4,6)
- [inputs/wide_bh_states.py](/inputs/wide_bh_states.py.txt): SI-SA-REKS(2,3), BH\&HLYP/cc-pVDZ, RKS seed; SA default pool + all-α |ab|, |ac|, |bc|; SI on 2S = 0, 2; TRAH
- [reks-studio.bib](/reks-studio.bib.txt): Documentation

## Data
- [data/cost_md.tsv](/data/cost_md.tsv.txt): Cost benchmark A: REKS Studio (Psi4) against ORCA and Q-Chem, one hot-start step of the tetracene dimer, BH&HLYP, 6-31G(d) and def2-TZVP; one row per job (92), tab-separated: system, shell, basis, nbf, job, code, method, space, kind, pair, status, wall_s, wall_min, wall_max, n_repeats, peak_gib, scf_s, scf_iter, s_per_scf_iter, resp_solver, resp_iter, resp_s, s_per_resp_iter, cpu_load_cores, cpu_note, stop_h, stop_label, reason, loose, version. Wall in s (fastest converged repeat; min, max over repeats), peak PSS in GiB, s per iteration where the program prints the phase time, CPU load in cores; loose: REKS run at e 1e-7, d 1e-6.
- [data/cost_psi4.tsv](/data/cost_psi4.tsv.txt): Cost benchmark B (paper v1): SA-REKS and SSR against RKS / RHF and 20-state TDA / CIS inside Psi4, 16 molecules, 322–1868 basis functions, BH&HLYP and HF; one row per molecule, functional and job (320), tab-separated: molecule, name, formula, charge, atoms, basis, nbf, functional, method, space, states, n_repeats, n_ok, rep_time, niter, wall_s, wall_min, wall_max, scf_wall_s, fock_wall_s, fock_calls, si_wall_s, rep_peak, peak_mb. method: rks = reference, reks<nn> = SA-REKS, tda020 = 20-state TDA, ssr<nn> = SSR; states: states computed. Wall and SCF wall in s (whole process; fastest converged repeat rep_time; min, max over converged repeats), n_ok of n_repeats converged; Fock wall in s over fock_calls builds; si_wall_s = SI step of SSR; peak_mb = smallest peak RSS over all repeats (rep_peak), MiB.
- [data/dissociation_c2.tsv](/data/dissociation_c2.tsv.txt): C₂ dissociation, M08-SO/cc-pV5Z, 161SI-9SA-REKS(6,6): one row per published R (169), tab-separated: R_A, E_S0_Eh, E_<state>_Eh of the named states, E_ref_<state>_Eh (reference points, E_fig_Eh; empty without a point), S0 natural occupations per active orbital.
- [data/dissociation_c2h2.tsv](/data/dissociation_c2h2.tsv.txt): C₂H₂ dissociation, BH&HLYP/aug-cc-pVTZ, 161SI-5SA-REKS(6,6): one row per published R (85), tab-separated: R_A, E_S0_Eh, E_<state>_Eh of the named states, E_RKS_Eh, S0 natural occupations per active orbital.
- [data/dissociation_c2h4.tsv](/data/dissociation_c2h4.tsv.txt): C₂H₄ dissociation, BH&HLYP/aug-cc-pVTZ, 18SI-4SA-REKS(4,4): one row per published R (43), tab-separated: R_A, E_S0_Eh, E_<state>_Eh of the named states (Fig. 3), E_RKS_Eh (KS DFT of Fig. 3), S0 natural occupations n1..nM in decreasing order.
- [data/dissociation_h10.tsv](/data/dissociation_h10.tsv.txt): H₁₀ dissociation, BH&HLYP/6-31G(d), 29082SI-7SA-REKS(10,10): one row per published R (83), tab-separated: R_A, E_S0_Eh, E_RKS_Eh, S0 natural occupations n1..nM in decreasing order.
- [data/dissociation_h2.tsv](/data/dissociation_h2.tsv.txt): H₂ dissociation, BH&HLYP/aug-cc-pVTZ, 3SA-REKS(2,2): one row per published R (91), tab-separated: R_A, E_S0_Eh, E_FCI_S0_Eh (FCI, same basis; empty without a point), E_RKS_Eh, S0 natural occupations n1..nM in decreasing order.
- [data/dissociation_h4.tsv](/data/dissociation_h4.tsv.txt): H₄ dissociation, BH&HLYP/aug-cc-pVTZ, 18SI-4SA-REKS(4,4): one row per published R (92), tab-separated: R_A, E_S0_Eh, E_FCI_S0_Eh (FCI, same basis; empty without a point), E_RKS_Eh, S0 natural occupations n1..nM in decreasing order.
- [data/dissociation_h6.tsv](/data/dissociation_h6.tsv.txt): H₆ dissociation, BH&HLYP/6-31G(d), 161SI-5SA-REKS(6,6): one row per published R (80), tab-separated: R_A, E_S0_Eh, E_FCI_S0_Eh (FCI, same basis; empty without a point), E_RKS_Eh, S0 natural occupations n1..nM in decreasing order.
- [data/dissociation_h8.tsv](/data/dissociation_h8.tsv.txt): H₈ dissociation, BH&HLYP/6-31G(d), 1934SI-6SA-REKS(8,8): one row per published R (171), tab-separated: R_A, E_S0_Eh, E_FCI_S0_Eh (FCI, same basis; empty without a point), E_RKS_Eh, S0 natural occupations n1..nM in decreasing order.
- [data/dissociation_n2.tsv](/data/dissociation_n2.tsv.txt): N₂ dissociation, BH&HLYP/aug-cc-pVTZ, 161SI-5SA-REKS(6,6), curves from Fig. 3 of the paper: one row per published R (65), tab-separated: R_A, E_S0_Eh, E_RKS_Eh, S0 natural occupations n1..nM in decreasing order.
- [data/quest3_rows.tsv](/data/quest3_rows.tsv.txt): QUEST3, every SSR active-space row of its molecule pages, tab-separated: quest, molecule, functional, state, active_space, TBE and SSR irrep and eV, delta_eV = SSR - TBE; used = 1 marks the value on the QUEST page.
- [data/quest5_rows.tsv](/data/quest5_rows.tsv.txt): QUEST5, every SSR active-space row of its molecule pages, tab-separated: quest, molecule, functional, state, active_space, TBE and SSR irrep and eV, delta_eV = SSR - TBE; used = 1 marks the value on the QUEST page.
- [data/quest6_rows.tsv](/data/quest6_rows.tsv.txt): QUEST6, every SSR active-space row of its molecule pages, tab-separated: quest, molecule, functional, state, active_space, TBE and SSR irrep and eV, delta_eV = SSR - TBE; used = 1 marks the value on the QUEST page.
- [data/quest7_rows.tsv](/data/quest7_rows.tsv.txt): QUEST7, every SSR active-space row of its molecule pages, tab-separated: quest, molecule, functional, state, active_space, TBE and SSR irrep and eV, delta_eV = SSR - TBE; used = 1 marks the value on the QUEST page.
- [data/scale_rows.tsv](/data/scale_rows.tsv.txt): Large molecules (TNS, TTR), one row per set and active space (12), tab-separated: compound, basis, functional, active_space, nbf, E_SA / Eh, lowest state, SI configurations per 2S, lowest E per 2S / Eh and in meV above the lowest state of the row, y0, y1 of S0, SA-REKS FONs, jobs (role, .out, cores, commit, wall s, peak RSS kB); n/a: 2S not in the SI of the row.
- [data/zethrenes_rows.tsv](/data/zethrenes_rows.tsv.txt): Zethrenes and related PAHs (Hu et al. 2016), one row per calculation (98), tab-separated: compound, geometry (R_cs, R_os, R_T), active_space, SI sizes per 2S, E_SA and lowest E of 2S = 0, 2, 4 / Eh, dE_ST = E(T1) - E(S0) and dE_SQ = E(Q1) - E(S0) / kcal/mol (2 decimals), y0, y1 of S0, SA-REKS FONs, source .out; n/a: outside the SI space of the rung.
